scheme_name: Promotion Of Intensive Aquaculture Through Introduction Of Bio-floc Technology During The Year 2021-22
other_conditions: Applicants must hold a license from the Coastal Aquaculture Authority for brackish water shrimp farms, nurseries, seed tanks or hatcheries
The scheme is limited to a minimum of 2 tanks and a maximum of 6 tanks per beneficiary
Priority is given to unemployed educated youth who must undergo specialized training on bio‑floc systems before operating the unit
Beneficiaries who have previously received subsidy for fewer than 6 tanks under other schemes remain eligible, but the total subsidy is capped at 6 tanks
benefits_summary: Bio‑floc technology increases productivity and income by improving water quality, reducing feed and water usage, and lowering operational costs.
